full_prompt_en: A square, flatly painted illustration shows two stylized figures facing each other inside a rectangular decorative frame. The taller figure on the left has an ocher oval face, a long narrow eye, a small angular nose, and a dark teal cap or hair shape. A blue-green garment fills the lower left, and one hand supports a shallow cream bowl with a red rim. The shorter figure on the right has a pale peach face, lowered almond eye, straight black-green hair, and a rust-red garment with a striped collar. This figure holds a smaller yellow bowl near the lower center. Their faces are almost profile yet show the eyes from a frontal angle, creating a deliberate folk-art geometry. A warm brown panel sits behind them. The outer border is divided into narrow vertical and horizontal bands packed with simplified plant forms: stacked leaves and buds on the left, repeated ovals and stems on the right, and small circular motifs along the bottom. The upper strip contains short alternating triangular color shapes. Thick dark contour lines separate mustard yellow, muted coral, terracotta, olive, teal, and brown areas. Color is mostly matte and even, with faint grain and occasional darker mottling suggesting painted board or print. There is no modeled directional light; hierarchy comes from warm faces against the darker ground and the regular border. The composition is balanced but not mirror-symmetrical, with the larger left form countered by the dense motifs at right. Its quiet exchange and repeating ornament give the scene a measured, intimate rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平涂插画呈现两名程式化人物在长方形装饰边框内相对。左侧较高人物有赭黄椭圆脸、细长眼、小小折角鼻和深青绿帽子或发形。蓝绿色衣服填满左下，一只手托着红边浅奶油色小碗。右侧较矮人物面庞浅桃，杏眼低垂，直黑绿头发，穿带条纹衣领的铁锈红衣服。此人近下部中央握着更小的黄碗。两张脸接近侧面，眼却从正面角度显示，形成有意的民间美术几何感。两人背后是一片暖褐色平板。外框被划分为狭窄竖带与横带，塞满简化植物形：左侧层叠叶片和花苞，右侧重复椭圆与茎，下部是小圆纹。上缘短带容纳交替的三角色形。厚深色轮廓把芥黄、低饱和珊瑚色、赤陶、橄榄绿、青绿和棕色区分开。颜色大多哑光且均匀，淡颗粒与偶尔较深的斑驳暗示绘板或印刷表面。没有塑形的定向光；暖色脸庞在较暗底面前、以及规则边框共同建立层级。构图平衡但并非镜面对称，左侧较大人影由右侧密集纹样抵住。安静的交换与重复装饰给场景带来有节制的亲密节奏。
style_prompt_en: A flat folk-art-like illustration arranges simplified curved silhouettes within a firm rectangular frame. Thick dark outlines divide matte fields of mustard, terracotta, coral, olive, teal, and warm brown. Small repeated ovals, leaflike loops, circles, and triangles fill narrow edge bands, contrasting with broader quiet interior shapes. Facial-like focal areas are pale and open, while the surrounding color fields are darker and more patterned. Surface texture is faintly mottled and grainy, suggesting hand paint over printed board. Light is not directional; value and hue separation give the forms clarity. The composition is balanced through unequal masses rather than strict symmetry. Repeated border marks establish a steady beat, and a few small horizontal pale accents focus the central exchange. Crisp edges, shallow space, and restrained warm-cool contrast make the image calm and decorative.
style_prompt_zh: 平面民间美术感插画把简化弧形剪影放在坚实长方形框内。厚深轮廓把芥黄、赤陶、珊瑚色、橄榄绿、青绿及暖棕哑光色域隔开。小小重复椭圆、叶状环、圆点和三角填满狭窄边带，与内部更宽阔安静的形块对照。脸形般的焦点区域浅亮而开阔，周围色域更深、纹样更多。表面微微斑驳带颗粒，像手工颜料覆在印板上。光不定向；明度与色相分离使形体清楚。构图靠不等量色块取得平衡，而非严格对称。重复边饰笔形建立稳定节拍，少数小水平浅色重音聚焦中央交换关系。清楚边缘、浅空间与克制暖冷对比让图像平静且装饰性强。
theme_en: Two stylized figures holding small bowls within a patterned frame
theme_zh: 纹样边框中手持小碗的两名程式化人物
name: Jamini Roy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
